originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Nearest priors: Inoguchi-Munteanu arXiv:2406.15886 gives Berger Levi-Civita/magnetic-trajectory preliminaries but no K>0 region, no pinching window, no systolic inequality; Chen-Gaspar arXiv:2505.09548 gives Berger widths/volume-spectrum (equatorial S2 attaining widths for small tau) but no positivity/pinching classification or systolic rigidity over doubly-warped rectangle; Olmos-Rodriguez-Vazquez arXiv:2302.11711 cites Volper/Berestovskii positivity iff tau in (0,4/3) for Hopf-Berger spheres and classifies totally geodesic submanifolds, but gives no 1/4-pinching window, no coupled (a,b) boundary, no systolic inequality; Brendle-Schoen and transverse sphere theorems concern general sphere theorems, not Berger pinching locus; live arXiv searches for 'quarter-pinched Berger', 'Berger sphere systole/systolic', 'Berger sphere sectional curvature formula', 'left invariant metrics S3 sectional curvature pinched' returned no overlapping classification (only transverse theorems, CMC tori, soul question). Draft honestly disclaims novelty for s<4/3 alone (classical). The sharp strictly-1/4-pinched window s in (4/7,16/13) with ratio=4 witnesses at both ends is not stated in any checked source and does not follow by decimal substitution into known formulas: it is a global interval theorem requiring solving Kmax/Kmin<4, however elementary. Boxes and systolic envelope sys^2<=CVol^{2/3} are likewise unstated. Hence headline pinching window + boxes + systolic envelope as combined exact statements are new.

Per value guidance, do not reject narrow exact datum merely for being one interval/constant; certification strengthens but substance exists. Incomplete [0.25,2]^2 census is honestly disclosed as not claimed and does not erase headline. Fallback boxes [0.92,1.08]^2 and [0.98,1.02]^2 alone are arbitrary-continuity boxes and systolic upper bound alone is one-sided sys<=Lmin algebra, neither would suffice alone, but they accompany an independently valuable sharp window and provide reusable checkable certificates and sharp constant C=2^{4/3}pi^{2/3} with round-metric rigidity. Not a textbook restatement (no source states window), not six-decimal substitution, not tiny unmotivated gain.
